name: branchpilot
description: A local, budgeted search controller for coding and experiments

scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js run examples/repair.json
scripts.bench: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js benchmark examples/benchmark.json
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm test && npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts --cache .branchpilot/npm-cache
